name: oh-my-claude
description: oh-my-pi harness features rebuilt as independent Claude Code mods.

plugins.name: omc-decision
plugins.description: A decision model for other mods ($.decision.ask): typed questions about a state, answered by any System One endpoint (Jev by default) or a small Claude model.

plugins.name: omc-effort
plugins.description: Auto effort: the decision model rates each prompt and the turn it starts runs at that effort.

plugins.name: omc-resume
plugins.description: Unexpected stops: when a turn ends right after saying it will act, the decision model spots it and one turn resumes the work.

plugins.name: omc-ttsr
plugins.description: oh-my-pi TTSR rules: a regex rule denies the tool call that would break it, with the rule as the reason; a question rule is judged after each turn.

plugins.name: omc-compact
plugins.description: oh-my-pi compaction methods: shake (move old tool output to files, no model call) and handoff (continue from a handoff document). Use `/compact shake` or `/compact handoff [focus]`.

plugins.name: omc-hub
plugins.description: Agent hub: a pane listing this session's subagents with status, model, turns and tokens, and a box to steer a running one.

plugins.name: omc-eval
plugins.description: A persistent JavaScript kernel the model drives with one `eval` tool: state survives between cells, and cells call Claude Code tools, models and subagents.

plugins.name: omc-panel
plugins.description: /omc: every omc-* setting in one pane (or `/omc set <key> <value>`), on top of the /config rows each mod already has.
